evals.prompt: Can you draft a technical design document for our new microservice using docs/templates/tdd-template.md as the reference?
evals.expected_output: A comprehensive Technical Design Document generated by first reading and parsing the specified reference template at docs/templates/tdd-template.md, then populating all structural sections (such as system architecture, component breakdown, data flow, and security considerations) with precise details tailored to the new microservice.
expectations: Reads and parses the specified reference markdown template before drafting the document
Populates all required sections defined in the reference template
Includes system architecture, component breakdown, and data flow specifications
Addresses non-functional requirements such as security, scalability, and reliability

evals.prompt: Write an architectural design spec based on the reference markdown file provided here.
evals.expected_output: An architectural design specification that adheres closely to the structure, formatting, and sections outlined in the provided reference markdown file.
expectations: Identifies and follows the structure and formatting of the provided reference file
Tailors the technical content to the architectural design spec requirements
Provides implementation-level details across all outlined sections

evals.prompt: Analyze our existing auth-service codebase at ./services/auth-service and use references/technical-design-doc.md to retroactively generate a comprehensive TDD reflecting its current architecture.
evals.expected_output: A retroactively generated Technical Design Document that inspects the existing codebase directory structure and configuration files to document the actual implementation state rather than a prospective plan.
expectations: Switches to Reverse-Engineering Mode upon detecting a target service codebase directory
Reads the bundled reference template for structural guidance
Inspects the existing code layout, dependencies, and modules to capture the true implementation
Saves the resulting TDD to a structured output path rather than only printing chat prose

evals.prompt: What are the best practices for structuring a TypeScript monorepo?
evals.expected_output: A general discussion on TypeScript monorepo best practices without triggering the create-tdd skill, as no TDD generation or reference template has been requested.
expectations: Does not trigger the create-tdd skill or attempt to generate a technical design document
Responds directly to the general software architecture question instead
